notes.title: Whisker Wanderlust | Steam Next Fest June Demo Release!
notes.notes:
[p][/p][p]Get ready for the super adorable kitty adventure – see the world through a cat's eyes (ΦωΦ) [i]Whisker Wanderlust[/i] is joining Steam Next Fest this June![/p][p][b]Demo Details:[/b][/p][olist][*][p]Free trial of Level 1[/p][/*][*][p]Unlock Level 2 by adding the game to your Wishlist![/p][/*][/olist][p]Collect and find yarn balls within levels to progress the main story. Interact with NPCs to accept quests and help them find lost items.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3603580/_/"][/dynamiclink]
[i]Whisker Wanderlust[/i] is here! Help a mischievous cat who ruined its owner’s 376th yarn ball by collecting replacements. Embark on a leisurely journey to see the world through feline eyes, where reality blends with whimsical fantasy. Along the way, befriend quirky companions, lend them a paw, and ultimately find your way back home. May every cat in the world be loved ♥♥♥[/p][p][b]Game Features:[/b][/p][list][*][p]10+ levels (including a secret stage!)[/p][/*][*][p]30+ interactive NPCs[/p][/*][*][p]1,200+ hidden items to discover[/p][/*][/list][p]✦ [b]Gameplay[/b] ✦[/p][olist][*][p][b]Main Quest[/b]: Collect yarn balls in each scene to advance the story and unlock the ending.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Side Quests[/b]: Interact with NPCs to unlock quests and help them gather items.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Secret Stage[/b]: Collect cans in the main story to unlock "Postcard Mode."
